prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universal **best** AI video ad maker; the right choice depends on whether you want **UGC-style ads, avatar ads, product-URL ads, or a full all-in-one workflow**.[3][6][8]

If you want a single default recommendation, **HeyGen** is the strongest “best overall” pick in the results you provided, because it is repeatedly ranked first for ad creation, avatar quality, and multilingual output across 175+ languages.[1][12] If your priority is **performance marketing and product ads**, **Creatify** is the most consistently recommended specialist tool.[2][6][20]

A quick practical breakdown:

| Use case | Best fit | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Best overall / avatar-led ads | **HeyGen** | Strong avatar quality, multilingual reach, and automated ad creation.[1][12] |
| Best for e-commerce / product ads | **Creatify** | Frequently ranked best for product and performance ads.[2][6][20] |
| Best for UGC-style ads | **Arcads** | Positioned as the specialist for realistic UGC ads.[3][8] |
| Best for short-form paid social editing | **Revid.ai** | Strong all-in-one short-form ad editing and automation.[16] |
| Best for broad, affordable feature set | **AdCreate** | Marketed as best overall for capability and pricing.[7] |

If you want one answer without extra nuance: **HeyGen** for most users; **Creatify** if you are focused on ecommerce ads.[1][2][20]
